requirements: R1: access is allowed only when both tenant identifiers are present and exactly equal
R2: cross-tenant access and missing identifiers must be denied
risks: auth.py::can_view authorization boundary: critical — incorrect implementation allows cross-tenant access
invariants: I1: no resource may be read across tenant boundaries

criteria.evidence: auth.py:2 — can_view('tenant-a','tenant-b') returns True; equality is not checked
auth.py:2 — cross-tenant access returns True, violating R2

selection_reasons.security: triggered by authorization/tenancy boundary (changed surface: auth.py::can_view)

checks_executed.result: resolved working-tree diff: auth.py (1 line changed), test_auth.py (2 tests changed)
only auth.py and test_auth.py reference can_view; no other consumers
2 tests OK — suite passes despite cross-tenant blocker

findings.claim: can_view returns True when both tenant identifiers are present but not equal, allowing cross-tenant access
evidence: auth.py:2 — return bool(user_tenant and resource_tenant) checks truthiness, not equality
findings.failure_mechanism: user_tenant and resource_tenant are both non-empty and unequal -> function returns True -> resource is readable across tenant boundaries

findings.claim: Required acceptance evidence is incomplete: no cross-tenant deny test exists
evidence: test_auth.py:7-11 — only test_same_tenant_allowed and test_missing_tenant_denied exist
python3 -m unittest test_auth.py -v — 2 tests OK despite cross-tenant blocker
findings.failure_mechanism: missing cross-tenant deny test -> implementation bug in auth.py remains undetected -> acceptance criterion A2/E1 not meaningfully evidenced

findings.claim: Missing-identifier denial is only partially tested; can_view('tenant-a', None) and can_view(None, None) are unverified
evidence: test_auth.py:10-11 — only asserts can_view(None, 'tenant-a') is False
no test for can_view('tenant-a', None) or can_view(None, None)
findings.failure_mechanism: resource_tenant or both identifiers are None -> implementation happens to return False but a regression altering the guard could go undetected

evidence_gaps.evidence: No cross-tenant deny test (E1 requires it); the test suite passes despite the implementation allowing cross-tenant access

minimum_next_action: Fix auth.py:2 to return user_tenant is not None and resource_tenant is not None and user_tenant == resource_tenant, and add a cross-tenant deny test
